identity.industry: Power T&D EPC + Distributed/Rooftop Solar EPC (grid distribution equipment & MV switchgear)

summary.oneLiner: Small-cap, asset-light EPC scaling fast (60% 9M revenue growth, ~15% EBITDA margin) in MV power-T&D and distributed/rooftop solar, now pivoting toward EHV substations and proprietary niche grid products (SF6-free RMU, FPI, VCB) — execution and working-capital discipline are the swing factors as it targets INR1,000cr revenue by FY28.

one-line thesis: Small-cap, asset-light EPC scaling fast (60% 9M revenue growth, ~15% EBITDA margin) in MV power-T&D and distributed/rooftop solar, now pivoting toward EHV substations and proprietary niche grid products (SF6-free RMU, FPI, VCB) — execution and working-capital discipline are the swing factors as it targets INR1,000cr revenue by FY28.
financial scorecard (9m fy26):
| Metric | 9M FY26 | YoY | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Revenue | INR185.6 cr | +60.6% | ~INR20cr deferred from Q3 to Q4 due to Maharashtra land dispute (now resolved) |
| EBITDA | INR28.17 cr | +58.5% | Margin 15.18% |
| PAT | INR17.92 cr | +53.5% | — |
| Order book | INR418 cr | (vs INR409cr prior qtr) | Visibility through FY27 |
| Receivables | INR146 cr (Dec) | — | INR30cr retention; rest within 180 days; 9M billing INR185cr vs collections INR148cr |

One-offs: ~INR20cr revenue deferral (Maharashtra ground-mount land dispute) — slips into Q4, not lost.
guidance (next quarter / forward):
- **Q4 FY26**: historically ~30-35% of annual revenue; this year expected even stronger due to the ~INR20cr deferral pulling into Q4. Targeting ~INR125cr Q4 execution; "will exceed projections."
- **FY26 full year**: original projection ~INR270cr; management expects to overachieve (analysts modelling ~INR300cr).
- **Order inflow Q4**: ~INR200cr expected.
- **FY27**: revenue scale-up toward ~INR600cr midpoint; transmission to become 3rd-largest revenue contributor.
- **FY28**: INR1,000cr revenue target. Niche products ~10% of topline (vs ~3% in 9M FY26).
order book & pipeline:
- Order book INR418 cr (Power T&D INR188cr; Solar INR220cr; rest civil/products).
- Q3 order inflow ~INR120cr (LOAs received; L1 not published).
- Qualified bid pipeline >INR1,000 cr.
- Pre-bid PSU arrangement: tenders worth INR840cr under evaluation, expected to close within a month.
- EHV bids placed: Himachal Power Transmission Corp (GIS substation) + PGCIL (~INR150cr tender).
- Solar order book (~INR220cr) executable in ~6-10 months; some electrical projects 2-year completion.
segment / subsidiary:
- **Power T&D EPC (MV)**: INR188cr order book; "matured business, high entry barriers, stable margins."
- **Solar EPC**: INR220cr; majority rooftop (govt), only 3 ground-mount projects (2 Maharashtra, 1 Himachal) — deliberately de-emphasizing ground-mount.
- **Niche products**: ~3% of 9M revenue, target ~10%; FPI (fault passage indicators) being pushed for national deployment.
- **Civil/other**: residual (hostel Odisha, etc.).
growth verticals / optionality:
- **EHV/transmission substations** (AIS/GIS) — revenue from FY27, to become 3rd-largest contributor; higher margin than MV.
- **SF6-free dry-compressed-air-insulated RMU** — claimed INR38,000cr addressable market; needs regulatory/market-driver (CEA, MoP, REC, PFC) adoption; long, uncertain timeline.
- **MV switchgear / VCB** — prototype finalized, going for NABL type-testing + customer pilots; minor billing FY27, major FY28.
- **FPI** — in national-level deployment discussions.
- **BESS** — bid but losing on aggressive pricing; participating cautiously "as per our calculations."
margins & cost dynamics:
- EBITDA margin ~15%; management confident of maintaining and "moving North."
- Drivers: matured high-barrier MV T&D market; scattered/rooftop solar EPC (less competitive than ground-mount); rising niche-product mix; higher-margin EHV segment.
capex / expansion:
- Asset-light EPC model; expansion is capability/personnel-led (inducted senior EHV personnel; new President — BD & Marketing).
- Developing proprietary digital project-monitoring tools.
capital allocation:
- Growth funded **majorly by debt** — bank facilities being ~doubled (some sanctions in, some pending).
- No equity dilution planned for now (explicitly stated despite an analyst flagging tighter capital-market conditions).
- Working capital ~30% of revenue deemed sufficient; PSU pre-bid arrangement lets surety/insurance bonds replace bank guarantees — eases WC and BG limits.
risks & watch-items:
- **Working capital / receivables**: INR146cr receivables; transmission entry historically lengthens realization (24-36 mo) — mitigated by focusing on substations (low ROW risk) and reputable payers (PGCIL).
- **Bank guarantee / BG limits**: analyst flagged ~INR200cr+ BG needs for INR5,000cr bidding to hit INR1,000cr revenue — partly mitigated by surety/insurance-bond PSU arrangement.
- **Eligibility constraint**: cannot bid large projects alone; dependent on PSU pre-bid partner (shares margin).
- **Ground-mount solar land/ROW disputes** (Maharashtra precedent) — being de-emphasized.
- **Niche-product commercialization timelines** vague (RMU especially) — optionality, not near-term earnings.
- **KMP churn**: Head of BD (Akhilesh Kumar) resigned (foreign assignment); replaced at President level.
- **Debt-funded growth** in a tight equity environment — leverage risk.
management quality / tone: Confident, execution-focused, candid on the Maharashtra deferral and BESS losses. MD engaged thoughtfully with a sharp investor on receivables/BG mechanics. Tone credible but promotional ("On time, every time"; "moving North"). Heavy reliance on hitting an aggressive INR1,000cr-by-FY28 target funded by debt.
non-obvious takeaways:
- The PSU pre-bid tie-up is the real enabler: it solves both eligibility (bid up to INR1,000cr single projects) AND working capital (surety/insurance bonds instead of 10% PBG) — but cedes margin to the PSU.
- "Order book" vs revenue reconciliation: INR120cr inflow but only INR60cr captured as revenue (rest WIP) — order book looks flat QoQ (409→418) because EPC revenue recognition is staggered.
- SF6-free RMU is a genuine ESG-aligned optionality (SF6 is a potent GHG; Europe/China/Japan/Korea already adopting) but India adoption is regulator-gated — pure optionality with no committed timeline.
- Niche products are only ~3% of revenue today vs the 10% narrative — the high-margin story is mostly forward-looking.
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary stock(s) | Loser | Why / conviction |
|---|---|---|---|
| India grid/distribution capex (REC/PFC/RDSS-driven) for MV equipment & substations | 544501·544501 (self) | — | Direct MV T&D EPC + niche grid products; visible order pipeline. High |
| EHV substation (AIS/GIS) buildout under transmission capex | 544501·544501 (self); Power Grid (code unverified) as anchor customer | — | New higher-margin vertical from FY27; PGCIL/Himachal bids placed. Med |
| SF6 phase-out / SF6-free RMU adoption | 544501·544501 (self) | Incumbent SF6 RMU makers (code unverified) | First-mover on dry-air RMU; but regulator-gated, slow. Low (timing) |
| Rooftop / distributed solar EPC for govt | 544501·544501 (self) | — | Majority of solar book is rooftop, lower land/ROW risk. Med |
| Ground-mount solar land/ROW & BESS price aggression | — | 544501·544501 (self, on ground-mount/BESS exposure) | Maharashtra dispute deferred ~INR20cr; BESS bids lost on price; co de-emphasizing both. Med |
| Receivables stretch & BG limits as scale grows | — | 544501·544501 (self, WC risk) | Debt-funded growth, transmission lengthens realization; partly mitigated by PSU surety-bond tie-up. Med |
qoq change log:
- Order book INR409cr (prior qtr) → INR418cr (Q3 FY26); split disclosed: T&D INR188cr / Solar INR220cr / civil-other balance.
- Q3 order inflow ~INR120cr (vs prior expectation of ~INR160cr from INR800cr pipeline).
- ~INR20cr revenue deferred from Q3 to Q4 (Maharashtra ground-mount land dispute, now resolved).
- Niche-product mix ~3% of 9M revenue; guided to ~10%.
- EHV/transmission newly entered bidding (Himachal GIS, PGCIL ~INR150cr) — revenue from FY27.
- BESS: bids submitted but lost on aggressive pricing — stance turned cautious.
- New pre-bid PSU arrangement disclosed (INR840cr tenders under evaluation; surety/insurance bonds replace BGs).
- KMP change: Head of BD Akhilesh Kumar resigned; new President — BD & Marketing inducted.
- Bank facilities being ~doubled; growth to be debt-funded; no dilution planned.

themes.title: Power transmission & renewable-evacuation capex
themes.need: Grid build-out to evacuate ~90 GW of new renewables is the broadest theme in the universe - pulling EHV/765kV transmission EPC, towers, conductors, OPGW, cables and HVDC. POWERGRID/ADANIENSOL TBCB pipeline plus state RDSS/underground-cabling capex (Rajesh Power 544291, OMPOWER) underpins multi-year visibility for EPC, tower (KP Green 544150, SKIPPER) and conductor/cable makers (KEI, RRKABEL, DYCL).
themes.driver: Fresh TBCB awards + execution ramp; EPC order inflows over next 1-2 quarters.
